description: Synthetic labelled messages for the deterministic emergency screen (EmergencyDetector). 'emergency' must all be detected; 'benign' must never be detected; 'knownLimitations' document false positives we accept in exchange for recall.

knownLimitations.text: I can't breathe through my nose with this cold
knownLimitations.note: Keyword screen cannot tell a blocked nose from respiratory distress; it errs on the side of safety.

knownLimitations.text: I overdosed on coffee this morning, I'm so jittery
knownLimitations.note: Figurative use of 'overdosed' is indistinguishable from a literal one.
